# Covista to Participate in September Investor Conferences


September 8, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/400572492/files/doc_news/Covista-to-Participate-in-September-Investor-Conferences-2026.pdf)


*Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference and 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference*


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Covista (NYSE: CVSA), America’s largest healthcare educator, announced today that it will participate in two investor conferences this September:


- Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference: Steve Beard, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Covista, and Bob Phelan, Chief Financial Officer, Covista, will present at the conference in Nashville, Tennessee, on Monday, September 14, 2026, at 9:10 a.m. CT. The fireside chat will be[available via webcast and replay here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FGhCtEPrzrHFSChRnGR9UnE%2FQx87p8vuggrLs8igP5fvTp&esheet=54599113&newsitemid=20260908721284&lan=en-US&anchor=available+via+webcast+and+replay+here&index=1&md5=c10dbc2c109fb5ebc6056e6c86d1cd8b) and available on the Investor Relations section of Covista's website at[https://investors.covista.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.covista.com%2F&esheet=54599113&newsitemid=20260908721284&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.covista.com%2F&index=2&md5=84a34d66b0d16e78afa3e5cf0fca11c0) .
- 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference: Covista management will participate in one-on-one investor meetings on Tuesday, September 22, 2026.


**About Covista**


Covista (NYSE: CVSA) is America's largest healthcare educator, serving 100,000 students and supported by a community of 400,000 alumni across five accredited institutions. Through personalized, tech-enabled education powered by 10,000 faculty and colleagues, Covista expands access to healthcare careers and addresses the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage at scale. Covista is the parent company of American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University. For more information, visit[covista.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.covista.com&esheet=54599113&newsitemid=20260908721284&lan=en-US&anchor=covista.com&index=3&md5=a3cc12e87d5e485fd29ac698bc26329d) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fcovista-official%2F&esheet=54599113&newsitemid=20260908721284&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=4&md5=80df3bc397fe8a3ddcd6122147f28172) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Flifeatcovista_&esheet=54599113&newsitemid=20260908721284&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=5&md5=1928d96d02ee1861277bd802c104b7cc) and[YouTube](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40OfficialLifeAtCovista&esheet=54599113&newsitemid=20260908721284&lan=en-US&anchor=YouTube&index=6&md5=71945a9577fd6ba100bcce84168f9a03) .
